caption: The drawing features a single oil lamp positioned centrally on a plain, neutral, light beige background. The lamp consists of a clear, ornate glass base with swirling decorative patterns. The upper part of the lamp is made of brass or a similar metallic material and has a round base which transitions into a cylindrical section supporting the lamp’s burner. The burner is crowned with a perforated, crown-shaped metallic section, featuring geometric cutouts at the top. A metallic knob with a stem protrudes horizontally from the burner mechanism. Below and to the right of the lamp, the name "Carl Biergernis" is written in small, neat script. No other objects or colors appear in the composition beyond the colors and textures of the lamp and the plain background.
title: Lamp
